title: A&C Base Frontmatter
description: The universal documentation contract: the seven fields every A&C Markdown document must carry. Specialized, publishable content types (case studies, core offers) extend this contract with their own schema; see case-study.schema.json and core-offer.schema.json. This file is the single source of truth consumed by the org CI validator (validate-frontmatter.py) and, transitively, by the website build.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Union of the content lifecycle (draft -> approved -> superseded -> archived) and the ADR lifecycle (proposed -> approved -> superseded -> deprecated), so one contract validates both content docs and ADRs.

source_doc.description: Provenance of the content (origin document, note, or generation method).
